questions: Are consecutive delimiters (e.g., multiple commas or spaces) treated as a single delimiter, or do they produce empty strings in the output?
Should leading or trailing delimiters be ignored (trimmed) or produce empty strings?
Are tabs, newlines, or other whitespace characters considered delimiters, or only spaces and commas?
Should punctuation other than commas (like periods, semicolons) be treated as delimiters or part of words?
Are words case-sensitive, or should they be normalized (e.g., lowercased)?
If the input contains only delimiters (e.g., ', ,'), should the output be an empty list or list with empty strings?
Should empty strings within quotes or specific escaped sequences be handled specially?
Is the order of words in the output required to match the left-to-right sequence in the input, or can it be sorted/deduplicated?
